limits: Three volunteers, informal, observed by the team, no timing of individual tasks, no formal questionnaire. Not statistically meaningful. The test sessions left content items in the live demo workspace.
limit_statement: Usability evidence is limited to three informal volunteer sessions; no formal study or independent accuracy evaluation has been done.
round1: Our Round 1 plan (Team 27) specified the Gemini API; Supabase/PostgreSQL with pgvector retrieval; a React frontend deployed separately; real user roles; image and DOCX/PDF review in scope; and Guideline-Clarity Insights, multi-format review and an evaluation harness as improvements.
